description: Maximum CMBS conduit loan for a property from its NOI and value: runs the coverage (DSCR), loan-to-value and debt yield tests and says which one binds, with debt service and the resulting ratios. Defaults are the edge of what last year's conduit loans of that property type were underwritten to, and the median coupon for the term; any of them can be overridden.

amortization_years.description: 0 for interest only for the full term (most conduit loans), or 25 or 30.

max_ltv_pct.description: Maximum loan-to-value in percent, e.g. 65. Default: the property type's 90th percentile.

min_debt_yield_pct.description: Minimum debt yield in percent, e.g. 9. Default: the property type's 10th percentile.

min_dscr.description: Minimum debt service coverage, e.g. 1.25. Default: the property type's 10th percentile.

noi.description: Annual net operating income in US dollars, e.g. 2000000.

property_type.description: Property type whose underwriting edge sets the default limits ("lodging" is hotel). Default all.

rate_pct.description: Interest rate in percent, e.g. 6.25. Default: the median coupon for the term.

term.description: Loan term in years; sets the default rate to that term's median coupon. Default 10.

value.description: Appraised value in US dollars, e.g. 31000000. Omit to skip the loan-to-value test.

name: size_conduit_loan
title: Size a conduit loan
